# Penelope Sloan

> Penelope Sloan is a brand strategist, creative director, AI systems builder, spatial designer, and Forward Deployed Engineer at Process AI. Founder of Penelope Sloan Creative (since 2009) and OPPORTUNI-P. 250+ projects across 5+ continents. Available for fractional and contract roles.

Brand strategist, creative director, AI systems builder, spatial designer, and serial entrepreneur with 15+ years building brands, products, spaces, and systems. Based remote / global (digital nomad, currently Latin America). Languages: English (native), Spanish and French (conversational). Open to fractional and contract engagements.

## Current roles
- Process AI (process-ai.co): Forward Deployed Engineer, Visual Creator, Brand Strategist + Designer (Oct 2026 – present). AI process optimization for SMBs in the US, UK, and Latin America.
- Penelope Sloan Creative: Founder + Creative Director (2009 – present). 250+ projects across 5+ continents.
- OPPORTUNI-P: Founder, Global Investment Strategist (2025 – present). 15+ off-market deals valued over $50M.
- Infoquest (Dubai): Select Advisory Member. Clients include VISA and Dubai Design Lab.

## What to hire her for
- Brand strategy, positioning, and identity systems (Soul to Success Framework, 10 pillars)
- AI agents, workflow automation, website chatbots, AI receptionists, AI photoshoots, AI digital twins, lead-generation systems, team AI training
- Interior, spatial, retail, and hospitality design; real estate concept and development advisory
- Investor decks, go-to-market, business development, strategic partnerships
- Fractional Creative Director / Fractional CMO

## Notable results
- $7M raised at Kabuni after reshaping its business model; publicly listed
- $140K single sale, largest in Percy John Flooring history
- 40-agent AI ecosystem built solo in Claude Code
- AI work typically saves clients 4–8 hours a week; one CEO saves 8 hours a week with his AI digital twin
- Winner, Urban Barn's Next Top Designer; Top 6, BC's Best Young Designer; Featured Artist, Hamptons Fine Art Fair
